# Outer-syntax fixtures

`record-and-list.k` is a reduced grammar-family fixture derived from the pinned K repository:

- `k/k-distribution/tests/builtins/collections/collections-test.k` (`List` as an ordinary sort),
- `k/k-distribution/tests/regression-new/checks/checkMacroRecord.k` (named record fields), and
- `k/k-distribution/src/test/resources/convertor-tests/userList.k` (user-list lowering).

The reductions are committed because the full reference checkout is intentionally gitignored.
